use_case_name: Solar Cells for Low Earth Orbit Satellites

queries.text: Solar cells for low earth orbit satellites must sustain high conversion efficiency under the radiation and thermal cycling conditions of that environment, and current incumbents leave room for improvement on both counts. Perovskite solar cells and silicon-based solar cells represent distinct paths toward that goal, but neither has yet displaced the other, and relevant advances continue to appear across the wider field.

Scout perovskite solar cells and silicon-based solar cells — as well as the broader review literature on solar cells for low earth orbit satellites — to identify approaches that improve conversion efficiency and long-term stability beyond what incumbent technologies currently deliver, across maturity levels from early proof of concept through to flight-ready systems.
